law: ADR-068: every stage cut prints an artifact, through a gate, to a fate. This registry names, per artifact class, the fates it may land in, the field that records the fate, and the gate that decides it. hard classes fail `scripts/fates.py check` on a value outside the set; soft classes are reported only (their vocabularies are still accreting; forcing them would be taxonomy overfit).

lore.gate: test_that_decided (a verdict without a test is rejected)
lore.notes: inspiration is deliberately non-terminal in spirit: a mood board pointed at until something real prints; kept as a fate because it is a declared resolution (ADR-044 aspiration column).

witness.gate: the human's yes at the moment (or accept on a backfilled stub)
witness.notes: y is the gut read, not a scored conviction; promoted (null | ADR/memory/DEWY id) is the second fate, set later by the promoting artifact's session. One legacy stub carries y=None.

falsification.notes: 40 rows to date, all FALSIFIED: the ledger records claims that fell. HELD is registered for a claim that was tested and survived, so a test that vindicates can be printed too (ADR-062: the falsifier must be able to say it was wrong to doubt).

source.gate: scripts/source_trust_emit.py (asymmetric decayed counts) or a pinned human ruling

rom-candidate.gate: the four graduation criteria in the registry entry
rom-candidate.notes: RC-OPS-001 is GRADUATION_INITIATED with 0/4 criteria met.

adr.gate: oracle-allocated number + merge to main; SUPERSEDED by a later ADR
adr.notes: DECIDED and ACCEPTED are the same fate in two spellings (44 vs 18 files); a future doc-rot pass may unify them. UNSTATED = the header has no Status line (3 files): allowed as non-terminal, reported.

backlog.notes: fates[] arrays are free text (30 distinct values across 62 items on 2026-09-27: published, parked, deferred, proven, minted, ...). Soft until the vocabulary settles; the status prefix is what check reads.

seed.notes: composted and molted are registered from the ripeness-resolution family (memory) though no seed has landed there yet; two rows carry dated ad-hoc statuses (named-2026-08-19, minted-2026-08-23) that a curation pass should normalize.

receipt.gate: POST /api/receipts/[id]/outcome (the human supplies matched/regretScore; a receipt cannot close itself)
receipt.notes: not checked mechanically here (prod DB); registered so the vocabulary is in one place. 2/247 closed as of 2026-09-24.

decision-receipt.field: (none) — a ship-event receipt has no fate column; what_confirmed[] vs what_unconfirmed[] is its resolution
decision-receipt.notes: registered as a deliberate absence: the receipt's fate is the merge/deploy it attests, which is recorded in git, not in the row.

assumption.gate: test_that_would_decide (required while open; a decided row must cite decided_ref)
assumption.notes: the ethereal-stage ledger: premises registered BEFORE the test. Closes into the falsification ledger (F-row) or a HELD row.
